app.name: Shelf-to-Shop
app.demo_banner: Demo: sign in with just a shop name.
app.offline: No internet. Check your connection and try again.

signin.title: Make your catalog from one video
signin.body: Walk past your stock, say each price, and get a catalog customers can order from on WhatsApp.

setup.title: Your shop
setup.notice_1: Your shop name, WhatsApp number and the catalog you publish.
setup.notice_2: Videos you record, only to make your catalog. They are deleted after 7 days.
setup.notice_3: You can download or delete everything in Settings.

record.title: Record your shelf
record.consent_1: Film your stock, not people. Keep customers out of the video.
record.consent_2: Say each price while the item is on screen.
record.consent_3: We keep the video for 7 days to make your catalog, then delete it.
record.preview_hint: Play it once. Can you hear each price clearly?
record.upload_failed: Upload failed. Check your internet and try again.
record.denied_body: Allow camera and microphone for this site in your browser settings, then reload. Or upload a video from your gallery.
record.nocamera_body: Upload a video you already recorded from your gallery.
record.insecure_body: Open this app from an https:// address to use the camera. You can still upload from your gallery.

processing.title: Making your catalog
processing.hint: This takes 2 to 3 minutes. You can close the app; your items will be here.

q.missing_price: No price heard for {{item}}. What is the price?
q.price_conflict_tag: {{item}}: you said {{first}}, the tag says {{second}}. Which is right?
q.price_conflict_vision: {{item}}: we heard {{first}} and {{second}}. Which is right?
q.price_conflict_multiple: {{item}}: you said {{first}} and {{second}}. Which is right?
q.uncertain_price: {{item}}: we may have misheard {{price}}. Is it right?
q.low_conf_mask: The photo of {{item}} may be cut badly.

catalog.title: Your catalog
catalog.share_text: See our catalog and order on WhatsApp: {{url}}
catalog.feed_hint: Upload it once in Commerce Manager to sell on Instagram and WhatsApp.
catalog.feed_unavailable: The Meta catalog file needs your shop on an https:// address. Your shop page already works.
catalog.feed_left_out_one: {{count}} item is left out of the Meta file. It is still on your shop page.
catalog.feed_left_out_other: {{count}} items are left out of the Meta file. They are still on your shop page.
catalog.none: Nothing published yet. Record a video to make your catalog.

shop.empty: This shop has no items yet.
